name: Stage 36:1: Nävsjön to Gälkhyttan
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 36:1, Nävsjön to Gälkhyttan.
utilities: Nävsjön has parking before the fishing association area, about 350 m to the stage board, plus pump, toilet/fireplace context, fishing permit machine, and bathing. Gälkhyttan has small parking/access, bathing possibility, and continuation to stage 36:2.

Public transport is poor at both ends: Nävsjövägen is several km from Nävsjön, Lilla Brakärr/Harsta-side stops are around 3 km from Gälkhyttan, and Nyköping C is the distant practical rail anchor. Gälkhyttan may have sparse pre-booked complement traffic, not normal walk-up transit.
waterSources: Official water on the stage is the Nävsjön pump at the start. Treat/verify because Sörmlandsleden water is not routinely quality checked.
No reliable refill is documented between Nävsjön and Gälkhyttan; treat natural lake/stream water as untreated and carry enough water.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 9 km; Naturkartan, Äventyrligare, AllTrails and OSM cluster around 8.45-8.53 km, including Naturkartan's 8,534 m and OSM relation 3696287 at about 8,531 m. Keep 9 km as the planning label while describing the measured drawn route as about 8.5 km.

Use OSM relation 3696287/Naturkartan for the main Stage 36:1 line. The OSM relation is a clean two-endpoint line but ordered Gälkhyttan to Nävsjön, so reverse it for official direction and snap topology to the shared Nävsjön node at 58.663211,16.734525 and Gälkhyttan node at 58.692472,16.809794; the official signed/access coordinate at Gälkhyttan is about 67 m away.

The 0.8 km Naturkartan 'alternativ väg' at Bötesberget/Stora Bötet is an internal route choice, not a separate branch in the trail catalog. The canonical OSM/Naturkartan main line uses the upper Bötesberget route; keep the lower ski-track route as an optional local alternative only when this stage is selected.

The branch is wildlife-rich and mostly easy mixed forest, but Bötesberget and Stora Bötet are harder: mire/boardwalk sections can be very wet in spring, autumn, or after rain, and the lower Bötesberget route had many fallen spruce reported in 2026. The Stora Bötet trail is a managed access corridor through wet reserve terrain; outside the marked line there may be no boardwalks and movement can be difficult.

Official current warnings as of 2026-04-27: limited passage under the powerline near Bötesberget from 2025-02-13, a dangerous rotten broken spruce near Tyskdammen from 2026-04-22, and planned Stora Bötet conservation burn/smoke during suitable weeks 18-44 in 2026.
Route sequence: Nävsjön, early Nävån industrial remains, storskog, Tyskdammen, Stora Bötet/Bötesberget upper-lower option, Gälkhyttedammen, Gälkhyttan.

Stora Bötet reserve rules include no damaging living/dead trees, no collecting plants/mosses/fungi/lichens except ordinary berries/edible mushrooms/personal-use flowers where allowed, no off-road motor vehicles, no disturbing wildlife, and organized camps/competitions require permission.

No food, potable water, toilet, or shelter was verified at the Gälkhyttan endpoint itself. The Överdammen shelter/toilet/fireplace is a Stage 36:2 or Gälkhyttan loop continuation, about 4 km away, and Pilthyttedammen reserve forbids tenting.

Gälkhyttan has N14 complementary/on-demand traffic toward Nyköping in some timetable patterns, but it is not walk-up transit: current researched notes point to Wednesday service, booking by phone before 16:00 the weekday before, and a four-person capacity limit. Always use the live planner for the travel date.

facilities.name: Nävsjön stage start
facilities.description: Official start of stage 36:1 and junction with stages 35 and 36. Parking is before the fishing association area, about 350 m from the stage board.

facilities.name: Nävsjön pump
facilities.description: Only verified public water point on Stage 36:1. Sörmlandsleden does not test/guarantee trail water; verify/treat/filter and do not treat lake water as a dependable drinking source.

facilities.name: Nävsjön hiker/fishery parking
facilities.description: Parking before/near the fishery area and permit machine. Parking inside the fishing association area requires a valid fishing permit; non-fishing visitors should use the free car parking in the slope outside the large parking and follow local signs.

facilities.name: Nävsjön reserve parking
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen-listed Nävsjön nature-reserve parking with dry-toilet context. Use local signs and avoid confusing it with the fishery permit parking.

facilities.name: Nävsjön access road warning
facilities.description: Nävsjön Sportfiske describes the smaller forest road before Nävekvarn as being in very poor condition; plan car access carefully.

facilities.name: Nävsjön toilet/fireplace context
facilities.description: Dry-toilet context at the Nävsjön/Nävsjömossen side. Fireplaces exist only where established/signed and current fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Nävsjön fishing permit machine
facilities.description: Fishing permits are sold at the north parking/fishery area. Permit required for stocked fish; current local rules restrict tackle, catch limits, bait fish and electronic aids, so check Nävsjön Sportfiske before fishing.

facilities.name: Nävsjön Sportfiske stuga
facilities.description: Bookable simple cabin near the start, typically for up to four people. Water is from a marked spring about 100 m away but is not quality-guaranteed; verify booking, access and rules.

facilities.name: Nävsjön Norröst shelter context
facilities.description: Fisher-oriented worn lean-to context near Nävsjön, not a guaranteed comfortable official overnight stage facility. Capacity/firewood/condition should be field-checked.

facilities.name: Nävsjön Öst shelter context
facilities.description: Small shelter context near the eastern lake side; recent map notes describe limited capacity and wind gaps, so field-check before relying on it.

facilities.name: Nävsjön kolarkoja context
facilities.description: Kolarkoja near the Nävsjön/Nävsjömossen side. Recent OSM/community notes report fire damage/charred interior and very limited capacity; verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Nävsjövägen bus access
facilities.description: Fixed-route line 561 corridor stop for Nävsjön access, but still a poor trailhead: about 4.7 km road/approach walk from the lake and no shelter mapped. Verify live service.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Distant rail anchor for both endpoints, roughly 13-18 km away depending on side; combine with bus, taxi, bike, or pickup.

facilities.name: Nävån industrial remains
facilities.description: Early-route cultural cluster near Nävån/Övershyttan: linbråkargrop, unique stone cold-smoke oven, smithy remains, waterfall, and 1500s ironworks context.

facilities.name: Tyskdammen dam wall
facilities.description: Dam/rest/cultural-history point before Stora Bötet. Pin uses the mapped locality/context coordinate; the official hazard is nearby but not precisely georeferenced.

facilities.name: Rotten spruce hazard near Tyskdammen
facilities.description: Official warning dated 2026-04-22: large rotten spruce broken halfway and hanging over/near the trail. Pass carefully beside it.

facilities.name: Bötesberget route choice
facilities.description: Internal route option: lower ski-track route by the mire edge or upper route over Bötesberget, 91 m. The main drawn relation/Naturkartan line appears to use the upper/summit-side route.

facilities.name: Bötesberget lower option condition
facilities.description: The lower 'skidspår' option should not be treated as reliably easy: a 2026-03-11 stage-page comment reports many bark-beetle-felled spruces and awkward passage, though passable with detours.

facilities.name: Bötesberget alternative route
facilities.description: Naturkartan lists an 805 m Stage 36:1 alternative route here. Show it as an optional internal choice when Stage 36:1 is selected; do not add it to the main stage distance.

facilities.name: Bötesberget powerline works
facilities.description: Official 2025-02-13 warning: very limited passage where the trail crosses under the powerline near Bötesberget due to major rebuilding work.

facilities.name: Stora Bötet mire crossing
facilities.description: Large mire/boardwalk area and managed trail corridor through a wet reserve with rich birdlife. Can be very wet in spring/autumn or after rainy periods; older trip reports describe boardwalks under decimetres of water, so waterproof boots may be needed.

facilities.name: Stora Bötet conservation burn notice
facilities.description: 2026 notice: planned conservation burn about 1 km west of the trail during suitable weeks 18-44. Smoke may be noticeable on the burn day and afterwards, but the official note says the burn should not prevent hiking.

facilities.name: Stora Bötet reserve rules
facilities.description: Do not damage living/dead trees, collect plants/mosses/fungi/lichens beyond allowed berries/edible mushrooms/personal-use flowers, drive off-road, or disturb wildlife; organized camps/competitions require permission.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttedammen grill/rest
facilities.description: Official grill/rest point about 200 m before Gälkhyttan with a fine view over the dam. Use only established fireplaces, bring fuel, and check current fire bans.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan bathing possibility
facilities.description: Official bathing possibility at/near Gälkhyttan; approximate pin by Gälkhyttedammen.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan access
facilities.description: Very limited Gälkhyttedammen/Stora Bötet parking and Stage 36:2 continuation point. Länsstyrelsen says about 3 cars; have a backup plan and follow local signs.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan industrial history
facilities.description: Historic mill/works area attested from the 1500s, with copper works, blast-furnace and water-powered hammer context between Gälkhyttedammen and Gälkhyttemossen.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan no services caveat
facilities.description: No verified potable water, toilet, shelter or food was found at the Gälkhyttan endpoint itself. Överdammen facilities are a Stage 36:2/loop continuation, not on core 36:1.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan N14 complement traffic
facilities.description: Possible on-demand/complementary traffic toward Nyköping, not normal spontaneous bus service. Research pass found Wednesday-only pattern, phone booking by 16:00 the weekday before, and max four travellers; verify live timetable.

facilities.name: Överdammen off-stage shelter context
facilities.description: Nearest verified shelter/toilet/fireplace continuation from Gälkhyttan, on Stage 36:2 / Gälkhyttan runt Överdammen roughly 4 km away. Pilthyttedammen reserve forbids tenting and permits fires only at the prepared shelter fireplace.

facilities.name: Lilla Brakärr bus access
facilities.description: Closest researched fixed-route stop to Gälkhyttan, about 2.9-3 km away. Sparse line 663/weekday-pattern context and no shelter mapped; verify live service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Äventyrskompaniet Gälkhyttan
facilities.description: Gårdshus lodging listed by Sörmlandsleden at/near Gälkhyttan with 6+2 beds; verify availability before relying on it.

facilities.name: Lasätter Gård
facilities.description: Lodging/event/catering venue listed by Sörmlandsleden about 2.5 km from Gälkhyttan. Treat as book-ahead off-route planning context, not a trail-side shop.

facilities.name: Planned Stage 36:1 shelter
facilities.description: Nyköping has announced a designed shelter planned for Stage 36:1, with completion/inauguration around late June 2026. Do not count it as available until verified built/open.
